environment.description: EKS pod in isolated subnet (no IGW/NAT route to 0.0.0.0/0) with Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP. Ingress is exclusively via com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ConfigConsumerRole. Subnet route table has no route to internet gateway or NAT. Security group sg-0xdeadbeef on the ENI allows inbound TCP/50051 only from the VPC endpoint ENI prefix list (pl-0abc123). Additionally, a Cilium NetworkPolicy in the namespace restricts ingress to pods with label app=approved-consumer on port 50051 only. The VPC endpoint has a resource policy that denies any request not originating from CIDR 10.0.48.0/20 (the consumer subnet).

config.security_group: sg-0xdeadbeef: inbound TCP/50051 from pl-0abc123 only
config.public_route: none - no IGW, no NAT gateway attached
